supportedClaims: Persisted bounded numerical evidence with independent observations and central Acceptance.
outOfScope: Quantum advantage, hardware thresholds, code distance or optimality beyond the declared audit.
Independent proof of SDK implementation correctness; QAOA global optimality without exhaustive candidate evidence.

checks.criterion: Finite binary quadratic objective or original binary model and equality penalties; complete global audit requires n<=16 and referenceMode!=skip.
Persisted result satisfies the JSON Schema.
Solver dimension and pinned SDK match.
Traversal and QAOA layers and classical reference roles bind to the requested algorithm.
Independent symmetric Q and constant reproduce the original objective plus squared equality penalties.
Normalized model retains all original objective and constraint terms.
Compilation digest matches its actual fields.
When QAOA is requested, the probability distribution and maximum label are consistent; this does not certify QAOA optimality.
Recompute every candidate objective, residual, feasibility, penalty and penalized energy.
Every claimed classical optimum has the independently computed energy.
Complete minimizing set and global energy agree with all 2^n binary assignments.
All 2^n compiled energies equal the signed original objective plus equality penalties.
At least one binary assignment satisfies every equality.
Every penalized global minimizer is feasible.
Reported feasible optima and complete minimizing sets agree with independent enumeration.
Every performed independent check is non-failing; missing optional evidence cannot hide a scientific contradiction.
Actual re-read canonical input and artifact bytes match their digests and actual Harness event range.
